SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sound Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Sound Energy.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sound Energy.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sound Energy.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sound Energy.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Classification of Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Classification of Plants.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Classification of Plants.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Classification of Plants.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Classification of Plants.

5. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. joule (J)

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink.

7. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

10. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat transfer? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat transfer.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat transfer.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Heat transfer.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Heat transfer.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water Pollution.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Pollution.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Pollution.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Pollution.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.

15. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Classification of Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain The Human Breathing System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Water Pollution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
